inputs.parsed: Exact original protein_groups_parser.ParsedProteinGroups from a complete successful parse of the raw bytes. Source project/file/raw-version-key/bytes/SHA, complete row/column/member counts must match the saved binding. Pure DTOs, booleans and row-preview slices refuse.
inputs.verified: Exact original fasta_intake_contract.VerifiedFastaIndex. Core revalidates the complete index shape and all-record manifest fingerprint against its exact original IndexCandidate; no metadata-only or truncated index shortcut.
inputs.binding: Internal QuantVersionBinding from a previously validated persisted DatasetVersion/ImportReport: project_id, dataset_version_id, raw_file_id, raw_version_key, raw_bytes, raw_sha256, parser_contract, config_sha256, report_sha256, row_count, column_count, member_occurrences. Same project as candidate required.
inputs.trusted_boundary: Caller verifies original quant raw bytes, saved report/config hashes/schema and full original parser result before constructing binding. Core checks linkage/shape/counts/members but cannot turn manually forged internal Python objects into raw-byte or Owner proof. Caller obtains original VerifiedFastaIndex through rebuild_and_verify of the complete original source. No client verified Boolean, authority Boolean, HTTP DTO or arbitrary path input exists.
inputs.counts: Quant row_count includes every imported record, not retained preprocessing rows or differential subsets. column_count includes all original quantification-table columns. member_occurrences counts original parser nonempty trimmed member objects, including repeated occurrences; no de-dup before mapping.

member_rule.source: Original parser's exact semicolon splitting and ECMASCRIPT_TRIM set, retained segment_ordinal is zero-based in the original untrimmed split field.
member_rule.empty_segments: Original protein_ids_raw and segment_count retain empty positions without allocating objects per empty segment; original parser never creates Member for an empty trimmed segment.
member_rule.identity: Case-sensitive literal equality against FASTA first-token ID. No case folding, alias guesses, sp| parsing, accession extraction or member deduplication.
member_rule.duplicate_FASTA_ID: Each member lists every matching record ordinal in original FASTA order; never select the first hit.
member_rule.evidence_join: Each member.fasta_record_ordinals joins result.fasta_records[str(ordinal)], whose evidence includes FASTA ID, ordinal, raw sequence SHA256, canonical sequence SHA256 or null, normalization_status and canonical_issue. The shared dictionary is a complete normalized representation of every matched record; it avoids repeating sequence bodies and evidence across occurrences.
member_rule.sequence_readiness: ID matching retains empty/invalid canonical records as matches. Valid/invalid canonical match counts and duplicate flags are separate. annotation_ready is always false; no annotation or unique canonical sequence is inferred.

row_status.unmatched: Nonempty members, none have any FASTA record match.
row_status.partial: At least one matched member and at least one unmatched member.
row_status.complete: Nonempty members, every member has at least one FASTA record match, including invalid canonical records.
row_status.partition: Exactly one status per original row; their four counts sum to complete original row_count. Full original record_number/protein_ids_raw/order preserved; no expression recalculation, row filtering or protein-group splitting.

summary: Row-state counts; complete row/member totals; matched/unmatched member occurrences and unique literal tokens; duplicate-hit member occurrences/rows; invalid-canonical link occurrences/rows; total expanded match references. Invalid link count counts each member-record occurrence, so a repeated member repeats its link count.

binding_and_determinism.input_binding: Canonical ASCII JSON of algorithm plus full QuantVersionBinding and original FASTA project/source/index-version/bytes/SHA/index-contract/config-SHA/manifest-SHA.
binding_and_determinism.binding_sha256: SHA256 of that canonical input binding.
binding_and_determinism.mapping_version_id: UUID5 fixed namespace d9bfaa48-f76c-50f8-bab8-771567941727 over algorithm + ':' + binding SHA.
binding_and_determinism.result_sha256: SHA256 of complete canonical JSON bytes; no timestamp or random field. Original member/record order retained, JSON keys sorted.

resources.overflow: Whole-result resource failure; never truncate, choose a first hit, discard a row or return partial output. Dictionary storage shares evidence, but every conceptual member-record reference still counts toward the cap.
resources.cpu_and_cancel: Existing original ParseControl and _Budget, real default thread CPU clock, maximum 8 CPU seconds for index proof and mapping combined; regular real checkpoints including member/record loops. No clock substitution or cap relaxation. Trusted caller supplies wall/memory/serialization admission policy; this pure function is not a process sandbox.
